name: codex-async
description: Codex CLI with a durable async control plane: background jobs return immediately with a job_id, persist terminal results and session IDs, and can be inspected, cancelled, or resumed later. On completion, an optional Heart callback delivers a durable Inbox notification so the owning Being can return to review the job instead of polling. Supports Codex profiles and per-job sandboxes. The Inbox notification is a signal; status(job_id) remains authoritative.

env.name: GROVE_TOKEN
env.description: Optional Grove Bearer token of the installer. Use your own token; never reuse the publisher token.

env.name: GROVE_KIT_ID
env.description: Optional Grove kit ID. Defaults to the published codex-async kit.

env.name: GROVE_API_BASE
env.description: Optional Grove API host for testing. Defaults to https://beings.town.

env.name: CODEX_ASYNC_LOOM_URL
env.description: Optional private Loom URL for completion callbacks. Heart Portal v0.8.0 uses its token query parameter for callback authentication. Prefer the kit-local codex-async.env file and never commit or share this value.

provision.post_install: After extraction, copy codex-async.env.example to codex-async.env in the Kit directory, fill only the optional Grove reporting and Heart callback values you use, then restart Portal. This private file must never be committed or shared. The kit runs without it; the corresponding optional integrations are then disabled.

tools.name: run
tools.description: Start a persistent Codex job in the background. Returns job_id immediately; use status for the authoritative result.

model.description: Optional Codex model; mutually exclusive with profile

profile.description: Optional Codex profile passed as codex exec -p <profile>; mutually exclusive with model

notify.description: Send a completion notification when configured

tools.name: resume
tools.description: Start a new background job that continues a Codex session. Returns job_id immediately; use status for the authoritative result.

session_id.description: Codex session_id returned in a prior job status

model.description: Optional Codex model; mutually exclusive with profile

profile.description: Optional Codex profile passed as codex exec -p <profile>; mutually exclusive with model

notify.description: Send a completion notification when configured

tools.name: status
tools.description: Read a persistent job status, final answer, errors, and current Codex session ID.

tools.name: cancel
tools.description: Stop a currently running Codex job.
